summary: Verified favicon fix. All 7 favicon assets served with correct dimensions/format. favicon.ico is valid ICO. PNGs are correct sizes (16, 32, 180 apple-touch, 192). Pixel analysis at 32px and 192px confirms mark-only content: green (leaves) + red/orange (arc) pixels present, black pixels do not dominate, and no long horizontal black band (wordmark cropped out). index.html at / serves the 5 expected favicon link tags after frontend restart. Homepage loads cleanly with no console errors; header logo renders at 48px height. 8/8 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html correctly uses %PUBLIC_URL% templating and 5 favicon links (ico + 16/32/192 PNG + apple-touch 180). Multi-res ICO (16/32/48) is a good choice.
Note: frontend required a restart to pick up index.html changes served through the CRA dev server on this environment — testing agent restarted supervisor frontend to serve updated HTML.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Favicon fix verified end-to-end. Reusable pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_favicons.py checks HTTP 200, PIL-parseable dimensions/format, pixel-content sanity (green+red mark, no dominant wordmark black band), and index.html link tags.
